[{"insert":"Cyclist Front Squat

The cyclist front squat combines heel elevation with a front load position. Both the heel elevation and the front rack shift the demand almost entirely onto the quads. The front rack also demands significant engagement of the upper back and core to stay upright under load. Keep the elbows high throughout.  If the elbows drop, the bar rolls forward, and the position collapses. All three working sets stay at the same reps with RPE building from 7 to 9.
"}]
